name: e-SCOTT Smart pro for WooCommerce
author: info@welcart

sections.description:
e-SCOTT Smart pro for WooCommerce plugin allows you to accept Credit Cards, Convenience Stores, Pay-easy, E-money Payments via e-SCOTT Smart system Powered by SP.LINKS.
This plugin acts as an addon to add a payment method on WooCommerce checkout page.
On the checkout page, our plugin connects to e-SCOTT Smart system.

e-SCOTT Smart pro for WooCommerce is currently only available for customers having their registered office in Japan.
And available currency is only JPY.

The difference between “e-SCOTT Smart light for WooCommerce” and “e-SCOTT Smart pro for WooCommerce”

  1. e-SCOTT Smart pro supports a recurring payment.
  2. In e-SCOTT Smart pro, you can update the status and the amounts in the WooCommerce admin page.
    Note: Even if you stop using e-SCOTT Smart pro for WooCommerce and install and enable e-SCOTT Smart light for WooCommerce, you will not be able to use the features of the light version.
    Please be sure to ask change your contract to SP.LINKS.
    And these versions can’t be activated and used at the same time.

About e-SCOTT Smart system

e-SCOTT Smart system is an online payment gateway Powered by SP.LINKS that allows both individuals and businesses to accept payments over the Internet.
The highest level of security of payments processed by e-SCOTT Smart system is verified by PCI DSS.
System guarantees convenience and instant order execution.

Service: https://www.splinks.co.jp/
Privacy Policy: https://www.splinks.co.jp/policy/

In order to use this plugin you will need a merchant services account.
SP.LINKS offers merchant accounts.
Please go to the signup page by clicking the link below to create a new account.

Signup page: https://registration.splinks.co.jp/input_woocommerce_pro.html

Credit Card Payment

Either token payment(non-passage) type or external link type can be chosen for credit card payment.

Online Payment Collection Agency Service(Convenience Stores, Pay-easy, E-money Payments)

Online Payment Collection Agency Service is only available for legal entity.
Your customers will choose the settlement type on the checkout page provided by SP.LINKS. (External link type.)
Payment status is automatically changed to “Paid” when the customer’s payment has been confirmed.

User Manual

Click to access e-SCOTT-Smart-pro-for-woocommerce.pdf
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.6 or newer.
  • PHP 7.4 or newer.
  • WooCommerce 3.0 or newer.
  • WooCommerce Subscriptions tested up to 8.2.1 (for subscription payments).
  • SSL certificate required (SHA2 algorithm, TLS 1.2 only).

Automatic installation

Automatic installation is the easiest option as WordPress handles the file transfers itself and you don’t need to leave your web browser. To do an automatic install of e-SCOTT Smart pro for WooCommerce, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu and click Add New.

In the search field type e-SCOTT Smart pro for WooCommerce and click Search Plugins. Once you’ve found our plugin you can view details about it such as the the rating and description. Most importantly, of course, you can install it by simply clicking Install Now.

Manual installation

Download page
https://ja.wordpress.org/plugins/woo-sonypayment/

1.Go to WordPress Plugins > Add New
2.Click Upload Plugin Zip File
3.Upload the zipped e-SCOTT Smart pro for WooCommerce file and click “Upload Now”
4.Go to Installed Plugins
5.Activate the “e-SCOTT Smart pro for WooCommerce”
sections.faq:
Does this support recurring payments, like for subscriptions?

Yes. Please upgrade to version 1.1.0.
To implement recurring billing, you must use the official WooCommerce plugin “WooCommerce Subscriptions” with this plugin.

In case of convenience store payment, payment status doesn’t change to “Paid” although the customer’s payment has been confirmed.

Please apply for “Payment result notification URL” to SP.LINKS.
If you have already applied for it, please confirm that there are no mistakes.
